summary: Diff implements a TREY-C Security frontend dashboard + global protection banner/modal, adds new security hooks/mutations, and adds backend TREY-C security state/logging scaffolding. Landing page CTA clickability appears addressed via z-index/pointer-events changes and explicit navigation handlers for some CTAs, but evidence for the specific "Order Now" CTA is not present in the provided diff excerpt. Backend admin-only APIs, rate-limiting enforcement, and deterministic stats/events behavior cannot be confirmed due to backend truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes callable methods for reading/updating security config (admin-only), retrieving security stats/events (admin-only), enforces rate limits when enabled, emits allowed/denied/throttled events, and blocks non-admin access to admin endpoints.
